scope: Read-only independent source/math/precision review of the EOF reader, permanent atomic chart rendering, and batched protected QA; not an actual browser gate

reviewed_contracts.contract: Successful done===true EOF releases without cancellation. Incomplete/read/size failures await cancellation and still release; primary failure is retained and cleanup rejection consumed. Reader size/SHA/decode/schema/math outside the private function unchanged; no asserted explanation for previous network aborts.

Four permanent attached shells are created only after validated data and selected exported observation; pre-validation refusal leaves no chart shells. Every width is measured before content replacement. Complete detached content for all four curves is prepared before synchronous commit.

Finite widths 0..96 retain complete existing drawing but hide all four shells and expose layout=pending/aria-busy; no fake width, clamp or invented points. Recovery redraws current selection even at old width. Negative/nonfinite width or render errors are fatal. Ready claims require actual successful render.

Unchanged original raw domains/samples/units: x=72+time/(window*30)*(width-84), y=178-amount/ymax*166; height210, x1=width-12/y0=12/y1=178, declared font11, one SVG unit per CSS px. Axis-only three-significant-digit text; paths keep six decimals and dots retain raw coordinate math. Structural biomass/FOOD/O2 in mol; declarations separately mol/m3.

One atomic actual detail snapshot checks its run/tick identity, 15 raw fields, exact original integer strings, medium accounting, genesis null residuals, live histogram/current richness versus historical richness and the same environment snapshot. Duplicate/missing batched fields refuse; synthetic controls include 2^53+1 strings and null-versus-zero.

One atomic comparison snapshot preserves pinned published nine displayed metrics and published min/max/width/count, exact string counters and unavailable null values. Existing raw oracle independently recomputes five integer metrics for 160 pairs after BIO scales match; browser floating paired differences/ranges remain comparisons.json pin assertions, not a new floating scientific recomputation.

Independent oracle uses original exported observations, observed viewport width and separately written domain/coordinate formulas; no product helper import. Every actual path point/dot and all four metrics/four seeds are checked with unchanged 1e-5 SVG-coordinate tolerance. Raw x/y axis anchors precede exact three-digit labels, actual CSS scale/font/clipping/nonoverlap checks.

Full source inventory remains 24 runs/48 genesis+terminal endpoints, 140 landmark+20 latest common pairs, 9 gates, 210000ms whole-gate budget. Five positive fullPage PNGs each require readiness, full raw paths+dots and typography after capture plus sticky error checks. Both negative captures require zero chart shells/hidden workspace/disabled controls again after capture. Four layout sizes and real keyboard/back/reload stay mandatory.

Bounded pending response/body tasks drain before reload and every page close; failed/body/protocol/page/unhandled/cleanup errors cannot become PASS. Final aggregate checks all three raw response pins on every page, 7 screenshots, 5 positive/2 negative postchecks, 9 typography records, all gates, unchanged clean HEAD/tree and sticky failures.

qualifications: This source verdict closes no historical actual browser failure: LAB79 CSSOM failure and LAB600 layout/network-evidence failure remain original FAIL artifacts.
Fresh protected exact-head full CI and independent original browser artifact review remain required; no transfer of previous 3D/regression/browser PASS to this HEAD.
No model, Cargo, native browser, million-frame decode, previous 3672-difference/2835-range arithmetic or author test repetition was performed.

Histogram comparison establishes exact CSSOM declaration serialization from original counts, not independently measured bar raster width; actual typography and pixel evidence require protected browser artifacts.
Pending hidden drawing is retained data, not a ready render of current selection. BFCache lifecycle is a source/synthetic contract only here.

Four paired seeds and sampled aggregate evidence support descriptive published comparisons; no per-tick ledger recalc, reconstructed cells/full genomes, fitness/species/GRN or open-evolution acceptance.
Unchanged official protected Chromium argv/sandbox policy remains required; stock SwiftShader if observed does not establish hardware GPU or kernel-isolation attestation.
written_scope: Only these independent evidence files outside source worktrees; no Git/source/raw edits
